position_rules: 256-bit entropy plus8 checksum bits;24 English words. Account/network/ZIP32 context remains essential.

external_secret.guidance: No mnemonic derivation extension in this exact mode. Local storage/unlock passwords are separate; never enter them into Tessaveil.

semantic_distinction: Exact English mnemonic mode with empty BIP39 extension. Imported standalone keys and old HD seed bytes are not covered.
